mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStat */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getUserTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , CONCAT('닉네임: ', U.USER_NICK , CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(U.INTR_CNTN), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('\n한줄소개: ', U.INTR_CNTN) END) AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getReportTargetDtl */ R.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(R.REPT_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_REPORT R JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending}) WHERE R.REPT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND R.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND R.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getReplyTargetDtl */ C.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , COALESCE(C.REPL_CNTN, '') AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TB_REPLXX C JOIN TM_REPORT R ON R.REPT_NUMB = C.REPT_NUMB AND R.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending}) WHERE C.REPL_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND C.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND COALESCE(C.DELT_YSNO, #{commNo}) = #{commNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getProfileTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , F.FILE_NUMB , F.ORIG_NAME AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getIntroTargetDtl */ U.USER_NUMB AS TAGT_USER , U.INTR_CNTN AS TAGT_CNTN FROM TM_USERXM U WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND U.USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending}) AND NULLIF(TRIM(U.INTR_CNTN), '') IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE /* delAutoChildReply */ FROM TB_REPLXX WHERE REPT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND UPER_NUMB IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptAutoProfile */ TM_USERXM SET PROF_NUMB = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND PROF_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})

UPDATE /* uptAutoIntro */ TM_USERXM SET INTR_CNTN = NULL , UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NUMB = #{tagtUser} AND NULLIF(TRIM(INTR_CNTN), '') IS NOT NULL AND USER_STAT IN (#{userStatActive}, #{userStatWithdrawn}, #{userStatDeletePending})
